log.msg: ITEM 1 DONE AND PROVED. Opening /websites/wikipedia-css/ used to request en.wikipedia.org before anybody asked - a browser fetches an iframe src the instant it parses, so a page view of any of the 15 embed-allowed records was a visit to that company server. Site.viewer() now draws one plain button and one sentence naming the host; Site.live() builds the frame only on the press. Measured headless with every non-localhost request ABORTED at the wire (so the measurement cost nobody a page view): BEFORE hosts on open = localhost:8123, fonts.gstatic.com, en.wikipedia.org with 1 iframe in the DOM; AFTER = localhost:8123, fonts.gstatic.com with 0 iframes; after the click en.wikipedia.org is requested and the frame appears. fonts.gstatic.com is the two webfonts framework/core/App/Font.js loads on EVERY page of this site - core, outside this fence, and not a third-party site being rendered. Written up in websites/doc/decisions.md with the table.

log.msg: FIX 1 - /websites/patterns/best/, the worst page at BOTH widths, rebuilt. It claims wide, and each of the eight verdicts is wrapped in site-best-verdict in best.md (raw div in markdown: the text inside still parses, given a blank line after the open tag and before the close). Above 76em the words take the measure on the left and the screenshot takes the rest on the right, capped at the 1920px it was actually photographed at so it is never upscaled. Grid rows are auto auto 1fr because a spanning item hands its extra height to the rows it crosses - without the 1fr the heading, the judgment and the link were dealt 300px of white between them, which I shot and looked at before fixing. Below 76em it is one column with the picture straight under the heading, so a phone meets the evidence first: at 400 the page opened on eleven lines of prose and now shows a picture at y=510 of an 844 fold, and it got 742px SHORTER (8880 -> 8138) because the intro was tightened to two sentences. At 3440 the page is 12,349px instead of 11,036 - it grew 12 percent BECAUSE the exhibits are now legible at ~1800px instead of illegible at ~700px, which is the trade I chose and would make again.

FIX 2 and 3 - the /layouts/ tier at 3440. A layout page's body and a tag page's site list now claim wide as .std-body, and .std-body > :is(.md, p) hands the SENTENCES their 40em back, so prose still reads at the measure and only the rows spread. /layouts/tag/cards/ went 1552 -> 1467px tall and its twelve site chips went from three wrapped lines in an 800px box to one line. FIX 5 - .site-viewer-range was flex: 1 1 10em in a wide band, so the width slider was 2700px of track at 3440; capped at 26em, because a control does not get bigger just because the page did.

The first version of the ask put the button and its sentence in one flex row and then replaced that row's children with the viewer - so the viewer became a flex ITEM and shrank to its content: 751px inside a 3260px page, no error, nothing thrown, and it would have looked plausible in a screenshot of the top of the page. ![a verdict on /websites/patterns/best/ at 3440 - the words at their measure, the site beside them at the size it was photographed](./shots/after-best-3440x1440.jpg)

**1 · The live viewer waits to be asked.** Fifteen records say `embed: allowed`, and their pages wrote `<iframe src="https://en.wikipedia.org/...">` straight into the markup — a browser fetches that the instant it parses, so **opening one of these pages was itself a visit to somebody else's server**, bought by a reader who came for four photographs. There is now one plain button and one sentence naming the host. Measured headless on [/websites/wikipedia-css/](/websites/wikipedia-css/), with every non-`localhost` request aborted at the wire so the measurement cost nobody a page view:

| | hosts on open | frames in the DOM |
|---|---|---|
| before | `localhost`, `fonts.gstatic.com`, **`en.wikipedia.org`** | 1 |
| after | `localhost`, `fonts.gstatic.com` | 0 |
| after the press | + `en.wikipedia.org` | 1 |

`fonts.gstatic.com` is this site's own two webfonts, loaded by core on every page. Written up with the table in [`websites/doc/decisions`](/websites/doc/decisions.md).

**2 · [`/websites/patterns/best/`](/websites/patterns/best/) failed at BOTH widths and is rebuilt.** At 3440 it was a 40em column hard left, 2,700px of empty screen, an 11,036px scroll, and every 1920-wide screenshot squeezed to ~700px — the evidence was on the page and unreadable. At 400 the first screen was eleven lines of prose then a heading then twelve more, with no picture anywhere, on a page whose whole subject is pictures of websites. On a phone it is one column with the picture straight under the heading — **742px shorter** and a photograph at y=510 of the fold.

**3 · The `/layouts/` tier used half of a 3440 screen.** A layout page's body and a tag page's site list now claim `wide` as `.std-body`, which hands the *sentences* their 40em back and lets only the rows spread — [`/layouts/tag/cards/`](/layouts/tag/cards/)'s twelve site chips went from three wrapped lines in an 800px box to one line. It is `clamp(18rem, 40vh, 44rem)` now — **unchanged at 400** (the stacked phone drawing was the constant's real job) and **2,848px** at 3440, on [every layout page](/layouts/2-sidebar/) and every site page's wire row.
